verses.text: We sat down beside Babylon’s rivers. We cried when we remembered Zion.
We hung up our harps on the willows there.
That’s where our captors asked us to sing. The people who tormented us demanded happy songs: “Sing us one of Zion’s songs!”
How are we supposed to sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?
Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand forget how to play.
Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if Jerusalem isn’t above all my other joys.
LORD, remember what Edom’s children did on Jerusalem’s day. They yelled, “Tear it down! Tear it all the way down to its foundation!”
Daughter of Babylon, you’re headed for destruction. Happy is the one who pays you back for what you did to us.
Happy is the one who takes your little ones and smashes them against the rock.
